meta.note: Fields under this_artifact_only are literal strings from one released PoC tool and are blocklist-grade IOCs for that specific artifact, not a general detection strategy — a rewritten exploit will not carry them. Everything else below is structural/mechanical and generalizes to any working exploit for this bug class.

trigger_paths: MULTIPART_EVENT_END with rfc1867_cleanup=0 and refcount>1 (SEPARATE_ARRAY COW), no stall required

spray_geometry.note: count (149 in the released PoC) is tool-specific; any count sufficient to reclaim the freed arData works. Detect on blob geometry/size, not a specific count.

offsets.16: IS_STRING_EX (0x106 LE dword) — fixed by PHP's zval ABI
offsets.160: IS_OBJECT_EX (0x308 LE dword) — fixed by PHP's zval ABI
offsets.200: "<dangerous_function>\0<cmd>\0" — "system" in the released PoC; exec/passthru/shell_exec/popen/proc_open equally viable

build_deltas._note: delta = zval_ptr_dtor - zend_call_function; per-build, not portable, and only needed to reproduce/validate the exploit — not useful for detection

this_artifact_only._note: literal to the one released PoC (http://jackalsyn.com/posts/phpupAssets/php-up-2026.tar.gz, sha256 0c254d547cac650bfbcb2275e30c2083737520a51a0511646f1fbb7ed60a0d63). Useful for blocklisting that exact tool/campaign; do not rely on these for general detection of the vulnerability class.
